label: To direct a thing to an end is to move…, from Whoever directs a thing to an end governs… and 1 more
meaning: Closes the quinta via's scope bridge STMT-DIRECTING-IS-MOVING (owner decision on #143, 2026-10-24: ST I q.103 plus a regress of directors): to direct a thing to its end is to govern it (q.103 a.3), and government is a change the governor effects in the governed (q.103 a.5 ad 2). Short: two steps through the readings; neither premise states the conclusion.
